error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the SmartSlydr API.
error.rate_limited: SmartSlydr is rate-limiting this account (HTTP 429). If you already have this integration set up, its scan interval may be too low. Wait a few minutes and try again.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the SmartSlydr API. Range: 30–3600 seconds, default 300. Each poll costs two API requests, and polling too often gets the account rate-limited — which also causes open/close commands to be rejected. Lower this only if you need faster state updates, and raise it again if you see rate-limit warnings.
data_description.base_url: Override only if SmartSlydr publishes a new endpoint or you need a local proxy.

upstream_unexpected_response.title: SmartSlydr backend returned an unexpected response

confirm.title: Retry SmartSlydr connection
confirm.description:
The SmartSlydr API returned a payload the integration didn't recognize — most often an upstream timeout. There are two common causes, and it's worth ruling out the first before reporting the second:

1. **The integration is polling too often.** A low scan interval can push the backend past its limits and make it time out. Open **Configure** on the integration page and check the scan interval; the default is 300 seconds, and anything below 60 is worth raising.
2. **A genuine backend problem.** If the LycheeThings mobile app also can't see your devices, the outage is upstream and worth reporting to SmartSlydr support.

Click Submit to retry the API now. If it responds, this notice will clear automatically.

confirm_with_reset.title: Retry SmartSlydr connection

confirm.title: Reduce SmartSlydr polling
confirm.description:
The SmartSlydr API has rejected several polls in a row with HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests). This is **not** a backend outage — it means Home Assistant is calling the API more often than this account's quota allows.

This matters beyond stale readings: open and close commands share the same quota, so while the limit is in force your door may stop responding to Home Assistant entirely, even though the integration and its entities still look online here.

**To fix it:** open **Configure** on the integration page and raise the **Scan interval**. The default is 300 seconds and the minimum is 30. Then give it a few minutes for the limit to reset.

Click Submit to retry now. Once a poll gets through, this notice will clear automatically.

confirm_with_reset.title: Reduce SmartSlydr polling

confirm.title: Retry SmartSlydr connection
confirm.description:
The integration could not contact the SmartSlydr API after several retries. Check your internet connection and the AWS service health. Your devices will appear unavailable until the connection is restored.

Click Submit to retry the API now. If the backend is reachable, this notice will clear automatically.

confirm_with_reset.title: Retry SmartSlydr connection

recalibrate_cover.name: Recalibrate cover move duration
recalibrate_cover.description: Clear the auto-calibrated move duration for one or more SmartSlydr cover entities. The next full open or close traversal will measure a new duration. Manual overrides set in the integration's options are preserved.
